services.title: Auto detailing

reviews.author: Iren Star
reviews.text: I had a great experience at this car wash! The staff was friendly, professional, and paid close attention to every detail. My car came out looking spotless, inside and out. A special thank you to Don, who went above and beyond to make sure everything was done perfectly. He was incredibly helpful, courteous, and made the whole experience easy and enjoyable. It’s clear that he takes pride in providing excellent customer service. I highly recommend this car wash, and if you get the chance, ask for Don, you’ll be in great hands. I’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Dominic James
reviews.text: If Google would let me give this place 17 out of 5 stars, I would. If I could personally nominate these employees for Employee of the Century, I would. If there was a Nobel Prize for customer service at a car wash, Dom, Cole, and Devin would somehow find a way to win it. I pulled in expecting my car to get washed. I left questioning if I had just experienced a life-changing event. From the second I rolled up, Dom greeted me with the confidence of someone introducing the main character in a movie. The man could probably sell ice to a penguin and convince the penguin it got a great deal. He explained the wash packages so well I almost asked if they had a TED Talk. Then Cole came over with the energy of someone who drinks straight motivation for breakfast. While guiding my car onto the conveyor, he somehow managed to make me feel like I was docking the Millennium Falcon. Not only did I get perfectly lined up, but I also felt emotionally supported during the process. And then there was Devin. This man noticed a tiny spot on my windshield that I didn’t even know existed. I’m convinced he has eagle vision with 8K resolution. He sprayed it, wiped it, inspected it from seventeen different angles, nodded in approval, and sent me through like he had just completed a NASA pre-launch inspection. The teamwork between these three deserves to be studied by scientists. Dom: “Let’s take care of this customer.” Cole: “Already on it.” Devin: “I noticed a water spot approximately 0.0002 millimeters wide.” Meanwhile I’m just sitting there thinking… “Are these guys secretly the Avengers?” The customer service was so good that I genuinely forgot I came for a car wash. At one point Dom asked how my day was going, and somehow five minutes later I felt like I had attended a therapy session. Cole made me laugh so hard I almost forgot to put the car in neutral. Devin was so detail-oriented that I briefly considered asking him to proofread my résumé. These guys operate with the synchronization of a Formula 1 pit crew. Blink once… Your bugs are gone. Blink twice… Your tires are shining. Blink a third time… Your entire outlook on life has improved.

reviews.author: Michael Chiodo Jr.
reviews.text: Exceptional service and spotless results! Just had an amazing experience at PureMagic Carwash! My car looks absolutely incredible - they did a fantastic job with the wash and every detail was perfect. I have to give a special shout out to Brady Loveland for his outstanding customer service. Brady went above and beyond to make sure everything was exactly right. His professionalism and attention to customer satisfaction was truly next level. It's rare to find someone who genuinely cares about providing excellent service, and Brady definitely delivered. The facility is clean, modern, and well-run. The wash quality exceeded my expectations, and the entire experience was smooth from start to finish. Will definitely be coming back and recommending this place to friends and family. Thank you Brady and the whole PureMagic team for such a great experience!

reviews.author: Frances Hernandez
reviews.text: Our family loves PureMagic Carwash for many reasons: 1. They are affordable... 2. They provide multi-access vacuum hoses... 3. They provide microfiber towels and cleaning sprays to detail your car... 4. They have a free air compressor to fill your tires... 5. They have free air hoses to blow things out of tight crevices... And last but not least, they have a great staff that greet you and pre-wash your car!

reviews.author: Christy Farmer
reviews.text: Dom was very helpful explained the options of the wash options and their monthly plan. Answered all questions I had. Great local car wash!! Wouldn’t go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Candice Champion
reviews.text: Great Car wash and great customer service! I like the little perks they offer members, car freshers, dog treats, candy for the kids. It's always working, no down machines, the soap is thick, the brushes are good. The vacuums are great, they offer free towels and spray for cleaning your interior and your windows. I've been a member since this location opened, it's the Best!! Extra kudos for Cole, he always provides a great experience and goes the extra mile!

reviews.author: Karen Orlick
reviews.text: Oak Ridge highway location is very convenient and the crew there always friendly and helpful if I need them. I'm generally highly opposed to subscriptions, but I must admit I love washing my car whenever I want, which is at least weekly. I used to pay per wash but this is a much better deal. At nearly 5 years old, my car looks like new and it is easy to clean all the details with the vacuums, blower, cloths and cleaners provided. So easy I don't mind doing it at all. I have had a few issues over the year, like not getting the right wash, but they have told me to just go around and drive through again and they will make sure I get the right wash, and they have always been very nice about it.

reviews.author: David Miller
reviews.text: This place had gone nothing but downhill. There was once a gentleman with longer hair that applied tire shine manually and made sure my wash was correct that is unfortunately no longer there apparently. He was their last good employee. The workers still don’t understand that they need to stay in the tunnel during the wash and spray my car down, but they still never do so. I never get what I pay for either, no wax, seal, nothing.

reviews.author: Ashlan Hudson
reviews.text: Best car wash! Will not chip your paint unlike some! Super nice employees! Also really great vacuums and car cleaning stuff! 10/10 experience!

reviews.author: Taylor Akins
reviews.text: Devin was very helpful! The car wash was clean, and I loved that there was a cashier instead of an automated machine to take money and answer questions. Loved this experience!

reviews.author: Jessica Gallavan
reviews.text: Went to get my car washed today and boy let me tell you, Brady or Bradilicious as I am now calling him, was so nice and patient and just a joy to talk to today. I'm bringing my daughter back tomorrow to sign up for a membership. I love this place!!!

reviews.author: Beau
reviews.text: Brady was awesome! He helped me out with the wash options and was able to give me wonderful customer service. The wash was great, it was fast and cleaned very well.

reviews.author: AMY FOSS
reviews.text: Noah is the best! I look forward to seeing his smile every time I come here. Great car wash, great staff, great service!

reviews.author: Dextter Kurtz
reviews.text: Austin Andrew was quick, informative, and kind. He helped me understand the best deals with what I wanted included. Excellent service!

reviews.author: Mike Kelly
reviews.text: Pure Magic Car Wash always does and outstanding job keeping my truck looking new. The staff is great as well. I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: madison grace
reviews.text: This place is awesome! They are very friendly every time I come through and always ask if I have enough towels and other stuff to clean out my car . Wonderful service and people working here.

reviews.author: Robert Armstrong
reviews.text: I’ve always been the type of person who prefers to wash my car by hand, but everything changed when PureMagic Carwash came to town. After just one visit, I was sold. Their facility is state-of-the-art, bright, clean, and far superior to the dark, outdated tunnels of old-school competitors. When they opened their new location on Clinton Hwy in my neighborhood, I couldn’t wait to check it out. I walked in, saw the amazing setup, and walked out with my first membership. I haven’t looked back since. A few months later, I ran into a minor billing issue and, like many others, I feared the worst. I expected to get the runaround, but my experience was far from what I anticipated. When I spoke to Jeff today, I was blown away by his professionalism and genuine care. He listened to my concern, immediately offered a solution, and went above and beyond to make it right. Not only did he fix the issue, but he also credited me back for charges I didn’t even think to ask about. Jeff didn’t just fix the problem, he made me feel like he truly had my back. The small amount he credited me will be more than made up for by the loyalty I now feel towards PureMagic. I’ll be singing their praises to everyone I know. It’s rare to see businesses that still operate the right way, with integrity and a focus on customer satisfaction. PureMagic has earned my trust, and I’ll continue to support them as they’ve always supported me. Thank you a million, Jeff! You’ve truly “cleaned up” my experience, just like PureMagic always cleans up my Tacoma!

reviews.author: Friendship Church
reviews.text: Super car wash!! 5 star experience! I love that they have the spray cleaners and rags. And shaded cleaning areas are very thoughtful!

reviews.author: Keith Hargis
reviews.text: Been a member since they opened and one guy told my wife her membership had expired. She was then talked into purchasing another membership that was a lease wash for same money. Two days later she gets charged for both memberships. We called help line and was not much help. I went in and spoke to the GM and thought it was resolved but a month later and still no refund. I ah e been twice this week and he is never there and I have even left a note on his computer for a call back. Poor service and this is supposed to be life convenience that has turned into a complete hassle.

reviews.author: James Williams
reviews.text: This place is actually a train wreck. They are so downbad that they are posting videos of the wash with all the employees being their only interactions. Have had multiple friends and even family members come through and have to file damage claims because the employees don’t want to watch the conveyer and just run inside without even foaming my car. Ridiculous that I pay 29$ a month and this is what I have to put up with. Do better.

reviews.author: Samantha Gibson
reviews.text: Traveling out of town for business and I stopped by this car wash. Devon was super kind and helped me out today. Great experience all around.

reviews.author: C Trouble
reviews.text: Incredibly clean, well stocked self service station and friendly staff very happy to help. Will definitely be coming back

reviews.author: Hannah Benedict
reviews.text: The customer service was incredible and my car came out extremely clean!! Will absolutely be back the staff was so kind.

reviews.author: Marshall Barnett
reviews.text: Great place! Friendly with clean lot, great vacuums, and I love having the towels to make the car shine.

reviews.author: Author Dionne Fields
reviews.text: I treated my car to an amazing spa vacuum. I even used the upscale car mate machines to clean my floor mats. Jeff, went above and beyond customer service, he was pure magic!

reviews.author: Jayden Collins
reviews.text: Highly recommend this place. Wash is always amazing but even better the customer service is always top notch. Noah, Brady, and Cole are always top tier with their customer service.

reviews.author: Hannah Royster
reviews.text: Love this car wash! The workers are always so helpful and kind. And they always have plenty of towels for detailing the interior after the wash.

reviews.author: Hollie Gasser
reviews.text: Pure Magic care washes are the absolute best. They maintain their machinery and they work to perfection. Best washes in Knoxville!

reviews.author: Andrea Mcdaniel
reviews.text: Glad this wash is so close to my house! The folks working there are incredibly nice! Keeps my pollen covered car sparkling!

reviews.author: David Zaharie
reviews.text: Always a great experience when I come get my car washed! James is awesome he helped me with everything I needed! I definitely recommend trying Pure Magic!

reviews.author: Haley Resseguie
reviews.text: Pure Magic on Oak Ridge Hwy was wonderful. The staff was very friendly and helpful, my car got a thorough wash, and the vacuums worked well. I will definitely be making them a regular stop!

reviews.author: Rian Foley
reviews.text: Great wash, friendly staff, went with my parents and Austin helped answer all their questions! Absolutely will be back!

reviews.author: Naomi Young
reviews.text: Awesome car wash! Fast, thorough, and the customer service was top tier. Super friendly staff and my car looks brand new.

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.text: I absolutely love coming to Pure Magic! The service is always great, but I have to give a special shoutout to Dominic, he went above and beyond. He was so helpful explaining all my wash options and made sure I got exactly what my family car needed. Even managed to get a little laugh out of me as he was pre-rinsing the car, dancing and clearly having fun while doing his job! The products they use are top-notch, and the vacuums here are some of the best I’ve tried, they actually get into all those hard-to-reach crevices (a must when you’ve got kids and a busy car). All in all, Pure Magic really lives up to its name. Great people, great products, and service with a smile. Thanks, Dominic, for making the experience a bright spot in my day!

reviews.author: Greg Hill
reviews.text: Very disappointed. The right side brushes nor the tire shine hasn’t worked for several months and isn’t getting my car clean. I am going to have to rethink my membership.

reviews.author: Phillip Cook
reviews.text: Hey Bryson and these guys here @ PureMagic are top notch, A1 guys! They took care of me, customer service was unbeatable.

reviews.author: Adam Doty
reviews.text: Pretty good car wash, nothing really different than others. The staff is very friendly and the vacuums are free!

reviews.author: Benjamin Lee
reviews.text: Really solid car wash - has everything you’d need and then some. Nice to have this place as a resource in our area!

reviews.author: Bobby Phillips
reviews.text: I came by today to get my car washed and take advantage of their vacuums. I ended up having to go through the car wash twice because they did not. Give me all the services that I paid for the first time around. I had to park my car four different times to find vacuums that actually worked. They advertise free towels, but they did not have a single towel available until I went and asked them for some. The only good thing about this location is the helpful young man working there. I doubt I will be back.

reviews.author: Buddy Perrin
reviews.text: At least half the brushes never work and doesn't get an even wash on your vehicle. Have tried repeatedly to contact them and can never get through to them or get a call back. Very unsatisfying experience.

reviews.author: Tee S.
reviews.text: Great customer service! Always friendly and attentive, well stocked with supplies, and complimentary giveaways.

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Stutz
reviews.text: Forgot my card and they kindly gave me a free wash! Always visit this location because vacuums are always so clean and working.

reviews.author: Will & Christy Farmer
reviews.text: The employees were very helpful on the questions that I had and assisted me in anyway I needed quick and easy location is perfect.

reviews.author: Brandon Nobles
reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic service, professional, kind and amazing. Would happily return here for all my car washing needs!

reviews.author: Annette Ferrari
reviews.text: Absolutely love this car wash. The staff is extremely polite and professional. That has been my personal experience. They must have great management because the staff that I have exchanged conversations with regarding questions, etc., have been very polite. Brady, the assistant manager at the one on Oak Ridge Hwy/Grassy is grrrrreat!!! Brady has excellent customer service skills!

reviews.author: Shawn Coker
reviews.text: Been coming here since they first opened. Fantastic car wash and excellent service. Very courteous and professional staff!

reviews.author: Matt Goslin
reviews.text: The only automated car wash in East TN that we trust with our vehicles. James at the Karns location was very polite and extremely helpful. Thank you Pure Magic for being the best at what you do!

reviews.author: John Dickey
reviews.text: To be completely fair, I received good service from this establishment for the first year I went here. Unfortunately, the car wash ripped the spoiler off my car. Now the staff did a great job taking my claim, but I received no compensation for the damage done to my car. I accept that by the letter of their policy I do not qualify but they could've done the right thing. Oh well. Then, I went to cancel the service I cannot use because of the damage inflicted on my car, and they tell me I cannot receive a prorated refund for the 3 weeks I will be paying for a service I cannot use because of the aforementioned damage. He said that to get one I had to call customer support because they are the only ones who can do it. Now having taken it up with their customer support, I have discovered that (according to the person I spoke to on the phone) that my membership was, in fact, not cancelled at all. So allegedly it has been cancelled now (we'll see). They also did not provide me with a refund either. Apparently the car wash has to do it. Nobody seems to have any real control over this business! Bottom line: If everything stays attached to your car after going through one of their car washes, they do a so-so job. If not, you're on your own. Oh, and they'll charge you for the privilege of breaking your stuff until the next billing cycle. I will miss the compressed air guns though. The ones that work are great.

reviews.author: Alyssa Pomaibo
reviews.text: Brady was awesome! Super friendly, professional, and went above and beyond to make sure my car looked spotless. He took the time to explain the different wash options and made sure I was happy with the results. You can tell he really cares about doing a great job. Highly recommend asking for Brady if you’re stopping by, you’ll drive away with a clean car and a smile!

reviews.author: George McGhee
reviews.text: The staff is always accommodating and friendly, the location is close, and I have everything I need to clean my truck.

reviews.author: Sharon Sutton
reviews.text: Love this car wash location. I signed up last year for the promotion of $25 monthly. After a year the price jumped to $42 per month. No email and no text advising of this change. I called to work it out and they had no desire to retain me as a customer. Very disappointing because it’s a nice car wash with great employees! Pure Magic, do better with loyal customers!!

reviews.author: Albina B.
reviews.text: This is my favorite PureMagic out of the surrounding area and good thing it’s actually the closest to my house. I like that every time I go there (which is very often), I am able to use the extra strong vacuums(assortment of 2 kinds) The spray bottles & towels are always available so I can stay assured that my car gets cleaned to the best of the best. Go Get you a membership and visit often to keep your car cleaned regularly and keep you feeling proud of your hard work!!

reviews.author: Melinda Arciga
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Pure Magic Car Wash! The facility is super clean and well maintained, and the whole process was quick and efficient. The staff was incredibly helpful, especially Ben, who went above and beyond to make sure I had everything I needed!

reviews.author: Lynne Skelly
reviews.text: Fantastic customer service! Dom and Austin are genuinely wonder people!!!!!! Come to this location for amazing service!!!

reviews.author: Macy Rhea Pearson
reviews.text: Friendly staff and convenient locations! Helps me to keep my car clean consistently, especially of dog hair. Their vacuums are better than anything I could buy to get dog hair out of my vehicle. Love the mat washer, especially for my extra dirty Wrangler.

reviews.author: brandon williamson
reviews.text: 10/10 would recommend my experience with pure magic in Karns was amazing I have been a long-time zips member but today I bought a pass for my wife and I and have 0 regrets the vacuums are better the staff was amazing and the bottle and towels are a great amenity. I will be telling my friends about my experience.

reviews.author: Brittany Scholze
reviews.text: Ok this is my favorite Carwash and best car wash company. If every company had the guy who runs the entrance of the car wash here (black guy here about 10:00am 5/16/25) it would make every place better! He’s the sweetest, professional and most accommodating person, he makes the visit even better! Best place for sure.

reviews.author: george snodgrass
reviews.text: Bout never found how to get a single works car wash. I've no desire to be a subscription for a car wash and resent it being continually pushed. Wash was good, but not that great. Like my newer dishwasher, it's only effective if you use very frequently.

reviews.author: alex myers
reviews.text: Today was the first time me and my children have been to a pure magic car wash, and Tyler made it the best experience. He made my kids smile so he gets an A+ in my book! He was super friendly and helpful. The car wash was great my kids were so happy the whole time saying now pretty it is and the guy spraying the car drew a smiley face on the window which my kids loved! They had my car looking brand new again when we were done! My kids were already asking to go back as we were leaving. We will definitely be getting the $25 monthly membership for the year. Thanks for such great service!

reviews.author: Jordan Miller
reviews.text: Just came to the car wash on Western and the new assistant manager Vinny help me out with a couple of questions. He was awesome newest stuff and had me hooked up with all the necessary things I needed to clean my truck. I'll definitely be coming back here just because of him

reviews.author: DZ Woods
reviews.text: Bad Customer Service! I went to Pure Magic for the $2 weekend special and I was told the only way to get the special I had to scan the QR code they provided and give them a 5 star rating. I made mention that I was at another location on Friday and I was not told I had to do that to receive the weekend special. The man preceded to say “this is what their manager required in order for me to precede”. I did the review just so I can get the deal. After I pulled off I deleted it. The advertisement sent to my phone said “ PureMagic: This weekend only - our car wash is just $2! No catch, just freakishly clean cars. Now thru Sunday. Don't miss it! Text STOP to opt out”. Well at this location there was a catch and that was to lie about the quality of service in order to get the advertised deal. Bad customer service!

reviews.author: Jeremy James
reviews.text: Two thumbs up! Pure Magic Car Wash lives up to its name, quick, efficient, and leaves your car looking spotless. The staff is friendly, the process is smooth, and the results speak for themselves. A go-to spot for a hassle-free clean every time.

reviews.author: Tucker Metcalf
reviews.text: Best experience at a carwash I have had. I am now a lifetime member. Very clean and very friendly staff.

reviews.author: Angela Taylor
reviews.text: A huge thank you to Ben and Brady, today, for taking their time to answer all my questions and provide wonderful customer service to me. My car shines brightly and looks fantastic. It was cleaned in only a few minutes. The equipment and resources provided to clean the inside of my car was excellent and efficient. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Tammy Stevenson
reviews.text: This car wash is fantastic! The actual wash does a great job. It's the vacuums that are off the charts! Really, really good suction that gets every tiny crumb. I can even clean my cup holders with these vacuums. This car wash has been great from the start, and it seems they are working hard to keep it consistently a great place to clean your car well. And yes, I have an unlimited membership and use it regularly. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: LIL D
reviews.text: Great customer service. Wash always fully working unlike the broadway location. Always clean towels to detail car. This is my go to car wash. Definitely will be back next time

reviews.author: Randy Richardson III
reviews.text: I love this car wash and visit almost everyday. I had an issue with my membership billing and went inside and was helped by Angelica who was amazing! She was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. She quickly resolved my issue and even gave me an additional discount. Awesome service! Thank you Angelica!!!

reviews.author: Amber Shinpaugh
reviews.text: Awesome place! Dom came around and made sure the vacuums were working. He also gave me some free air fresheners! I really like/appreciate/enjoyed this car wash visit.

reviews.author: Melissa Merritt
reviews.text: Don’t use Pure Magic unless you want to be ripped off. I canceled my service and was billed anyway. I emailed them when it happened trying to fix it. It happened in June. They refuse to give me the month of service that I paid for or a refund.

reviews.author: Mike Russell
reviews.text: I go to 5 different Pure Magic locations - this is the BEST of the 5. Always clean, the associates are great. The equipment is always working. (Brushes, blowers). I love the air blows at the vacuum stations. The rotation polishing rags are in great shape. One of the other locations the polishers aren’t rotating. Good job in Karns.

reviews.author: Brielle Garson
reviews.text: Every time I visit Pure Magic Car Wash, I leave impressed, but this last visit was exceptional thanks to Brady. He greeted me with a big smile and made the whole process smooth and easy. You can tell he takes pride in his work and genuinely cares about the customer experience. Brady answered my questions without rushing me, helped me choose the right wash, and made sure everything was handled perfectly. It’s the little things, like great attitude that make a big difference, and Brady nails it! If you're looking for a place where both your car and you are treated with care, Pure Magic is the spot, and Brady is the guy to see!

reviews.author: Karen Franklin
reviews.text: always have great service at this car wash. we come here frequently to have our vehicles washed. never had any issues with car wash or vacuums or supplies to even clean car interior.

reviews.author: christopher ayers
reviews.text: I have always go here and I always have the best experience at this pure magic. And they are so friendly the car wash does a great job on my car. I have a black car I always ask them to turn off the brushes cause I don’t want swirl marks in my paint and they always do that for me. Your doing a great job guys keep it up. Make you Oakridge hwy can teach the Emory rd location a few things

reviews.author: Bre S
reviews.text: I got to meet the wonderful team members Marlon, Angelica, and June. They were able to help me with the questions I had. I won’t ever go to another Pure Magic Car Wash. Even though this one it out the way for me, I felt cared for. Thank you to these wonderful people.

reviews.author: Mark Garland
reviews.text: Always good to get the car washed frequently, birds and trees may be everyday issue, but friendly service keeps me coming back.

reviews.author: X me
reviews.text: Check the results before driving away. The process left a lot of specs and spots of soap on my car. Definitely a rinse issue. So be carefull and check before you go. $17 should have done MUCH better.

reviews.author: Myia Bell
reviews.text: Do NOT under any circumstances go here to get your car washed. They have had numerous problems with cars getting stuck. My mother was involved in an instance where it would not kick her out of the wash and her and another car are honking their horns trying to get the workers to stop the track. They do not stop the track and not only does she end up getting hit by the car behind her, but the car following that does as well. 3 cars were stuck and my mom has a dent in her brand new 2025 car. She filed a claim with Pure Magic but was denied?! How I have no idea because she could not move her car out of the wash and was therefore hit from behind, all while trying to tell the workers to stop. Come to find out this is not the only instance. I’ve talked to numerous others who were stopped and even hit within this car wash. Customer service does absolutely nothing to help you. Such a shame. Please don’t give them your business.

reviews.author: Jenny Phillips
reviews.text: This pure magic is great! Marlon is the best!!! He is so nice, helpful and funny! He really made my day today, and I hope he is appreciated, because honestly, I won't go anywhere else so long as Marlon is working there!!!

reviews.author: Sarah Schmid
reviews.text: Love PureMagic!! Always leave happy and the staff is always very friendly. Multiple locations are convenient for a quick stop. The self service stations are always stocked and great for a deep clean.

reviews.author: Dana Wild
reviews.text: I’ve always had a good experience with Pure Magic and it does a great job on my Ram 2500! Thanks for your great customer service Ben.

reviews.author: Zavanna Dawson
reviews.text: Angelica is so sweet! They have such a good energy to them. This car wash not only has my car feeling clean but I’m feeling clean too lol

reviews.author: Heather Reynolds
reviews.text: After using other local car washes, I must say I am very pleased with Pure Magic and this location. I got the new location special of $25 per month for the Premium membership. The staff is friendly. Vacuums always work great! Air guns for pesky dust in the tough to reach places. Always a good supply of clean microfiber rags. My vehicle may be older, but I enjoy driving a clean car. I generally go in the morning, but it still gets very hot in the sun. The only thing that could make it better is shade where the vacuums/cleaning stations are, especially as we head into hot summer months.

reviews.author: Jason Douglas
reviews.text: One employee named Marlin is the most friendly and hardest working person I’ve seen at any pure magic car wash. I use their facilities at least 4 times a week and I’ll drive out of my way to go to marlins wash. Extremely helpful always smiling and always working when I’m there. Give the man a giant pay raise and let him train your other employees. He’s first class

reviews.author: Carol Howell
reviews.text: This is the BEST car wash around! It does a spectacular job at cleaning your car on the outside and offers many different tools to help you clean it on the inside, including all purpose cleaner, vacuums, mat cleaners and washer fluid! If that’s not enough to convince you to come here, the customer service will do you in! Cannot brag enough on this place.

reviews.author: Melissa Blume
reviews.text: I went by this new location and I had seen an add on FB from Pure Magic to get $10 off the Max wash for Teachers & First Responders this week. The cashier wasn't aware of this promotion when I showed him the pic of the add I had seen, but he told me "don't worry about it" and let me pick a car wash for free! The wash definitely did it's job and even better that it was free! I will definitely be back & will most likely get the monthly pass. I did use the vacuums, & dang, they were super strong!!

reviews.author: Bryson
reviews.text: Jake and Ben did a great job on my truck! Will definitely be bring my truck there every time I need a great wash!!! Great facility and amenities! Got the outside and inside looking great!

reviews.author: Jasmin Torres
reviews.text: Staff is always so friendly. Angelica is great with my kids. They want to come by each time they see it. She is always Drawing little happy faces on the window, offering lollipops, even gave my dog a treat. She’s always in high spirits when I go. Love it here.

reviews.author: NotFamFriendly
reviews.text: The customer service here was absolutely amazing! I typically don't buy-in to subscription based services but, I couldn't pass up the deals these guys have to offer! Y'all have earned yourselves a lifelong customer! And thank you to Jess for making my day, I appreciate you!

reviews.author: Heath Tunnell
reviews.text: Great car wash! They have all the things and all the extra things to clean your car and they are all complementary. Marlon was a great help and even pressure washed one of my rubber mats for my truck. Great team and business!

reviews.author: Julie Morrow
reviews.text: This location is by far the best! The staff is so friendly and helpful. I interacted with 3 staff members today and all three were exceptional! One offered my kiddos lollipops through me, which was very kind. When an employee named Jeff noticed we were still there as I was vacuuming my vehicle and its extremely hot outside.... he came up and kindly asked if it would be okay to give my two 3 year olds popsicles! They loved it and it was truly the best experience. He was so kind and professional. So wonderful! They all were. I actually live closer to a different location but go to the Oak Ridge Highway one specifically because they're the best!!! Such kindness!!! Id give them 10 stars if I could!!!! I'll only ever go here for my vehicle. Well done guys!!

reviews.author: Brady Loveland
reviews.text: Amazing car wash! Brady helped me out at window. This was my first time coming to the pure magic in Karns. Definitely the best one so far! Marlon was super kind and helped me get my car into the tunnel. I love all of the colors they have. Thank you Karns Puremagic.

reviews.author: Allie McCosh
reviews.text: Pure Magic is my go-to car wash! The service was beyond amazing. an employee named Marlon came out and offered to pressure wash my floor mats for me just to go the ‘extra mile.’ I truly appreciate the customer service he gave! Definitely recommend over other local car washes!

reviews.author: Tiekel Finnikin
reviews.text: Ben was very helpful. I love taking my vehicles there. It’s always nice, clean, and everything works. Highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Q. Hazel Eyes
reviews.text: This place is one of the best Clean and organized car wash.. it’s never full And I must say the employees including management (Angelica)they are all so kind and very professional.great job guys keep up the good work.. this is my new favorite car wash!!

reviews.author: Amy Crayton
reviews.text: When I pulled up, I tried to pay with cash I am a real spaz but thankfully Brady and Angelica were so kind and patient with me. I will definitely be back because of their excellent customer service!

reviews.author: David A
reviews.text: I got a free wash through a promotion, it gives you the max wash, and considering this is normally a $30+ wash and there best, I was thoroughly disappointed. The dude applying the pre-soak barely misted the vehicle, the wash honestly didn’t last that long and the rear of the vehicle looked untouched. Yes I understand it’s free this time, but wow to pay this much for results I get from touchless washes is sad.

reviews.author: Karen Garson
reviews.text: Great car wash. Young man named Brady was very helpful. Thank you Pure Magic for such a great experience. I will continue to be a customer.

reviews.author: greg cox
reviews.text: best pure magic around always clean and well stocked with towels i love the mat cleaner and free air for my tires.

reviews.author: Tabatha Rowe
reviews.text: Super nice employees, the vacuums actually work, and my car does come out clean in the end. Love that there are mat cleaners as well!

reviews.author: Ms. Joey Williams
reviews.text: Levi and Devin had incredible customer service. Levi made my whole day going above and beyond!! Will be back 10/10!

reviews.author: Nautica Love
reviews.text: Tj the general manger was very helpful and nice! He needs a raise he informed me with a lot of promotion's and Brody was sweet as welll very nice crew and nice wash experience !

reviews.author: Mike Barrett
reviews.text: First time using this car wash and it damaged my vehicle. I reported it to the manager on duty and was told they would be in touch with me. It’s been over 2 days and nothing. We will see.. Well, it has been awhile and no one has contacted me. Be careful at the end of the wash where the tire cleaner is. That is where they are having problems. I have heard from 2 other people that have had the same issue.

reviews.author: Chandler Bradley
reviews.text: First timer here and James was really helpful and ensured I had a great grasp of how everything went down! I like all the options of washes provided as well. This place is newer and super nice, so I think you’re getting your money’s worth! The staff is really friendly too! Will come back for sure

reviews.author: Jamie ODonnell
reviews.text: Love taking my car here to get washed. They have everything I need to clean my car myself inside and out.

reviews.author: Toby Champion
reviews.text: This car wash is newer to the area and does a great job! The people are friendly and the services are really good. My son even likes the suckers that they give away.

reviews.author: Amber Driggs
reviews.text: Fav place to get my car cleaned! Also, sweet staff always giving kids suckers! Great customer service!

reviews.author: Douglas Bieber
reviews.text: Had an awesome experience at this location! Sam C. was kind enough to walk me through how everything worked and where all of the awesome amenities were too. He even went the extra mile and took my floor mats so he could wash them himself! Would recommend anyone to go to this new location.

reviews.author: Melissa Crosby
reviews.text: Great cash wash. Very clean and the workers are very friendly. I’ve had a membership with them for over a year. Never a bad experience.

reviews.author: JAKOB GULLEDGE
reviews.text: The location was very easy to access, the car wash was thorough without being too aggressive, and there was no residue left behind once it was finished.

reviews.author: Pam O
reviews.text: My only complaint about this location is that they need to start spraying the pre-wash on it before you actually go into the car wash. Everything else is awesome about this car wash location

reviews.author: Burgess Baxter
reviews.text: My wife went to this location as we live down the street. She tried to use cash and tap to pay but they do not take either payment option. On top of that the young man working there was extremely rude to my wife.

reviews.author: Nancy Pelfrey
reviews.text: Love the new Karns location. Very happy with car wash and appreciate all the amenities provided -towels, mat wash, air fresheners, windshield solution refill station, etc. Staff is very friendly and professional.

reviews.author: Natalie Summers
reviews.text: Cleans!!! Love the extras…cleaning cloths, spray, mini air blower for vents & hard to reach areas. Nice staff. Glad to have this car wash business in Karns!

reviews.author: Cindy Van Riet
reviews.text: Wow, very friendly! I went in for my first wash with puremagic and was very impressed. A much better wash than most run-through carwashes.

reviews.author: Tom Stanford
reviews.text: Fantastic car wash. Great resources to detail your vehicle after going through wash (strong vacuums, towels, spray, etc.)

reviews.author: Mason Baird
reviews.text: I was at the oak ridge hwy location and Sam was so nice and helpful! He was great with my niece and nephew. Will definitely be coming back to this location if he’s here!

reviews.author: Aubrey Fisher
reviews.text: I asked the men working to turn off the spinner on my new vehicle and they said of course and they never did. This frustrated me so much and I will never come back here. Don’t suggest

reviews.author: Debra Deal
reviews.text: Love this place. I'm here almost every day. Marlin is the best. Very friendly and welcoming. Great vacuums too.
